page.layout: One page of text at top, full width; below it one diagram (a circle with radii and planet symbols, labelled ORT, OCCASUS, MERIDIES, SEPTENTRIO, with letters) and small letters G, 2, Si at the foot of the diagram. No margin notes.

main_text.p: as demonstrationes assumpsit. Quibus praetermis- sis ne nouitate hypothesium offendantur aut con- turbentur Tyrones, terrae mediam mundi sedem attribuimus, & centrum uniuersi statuimus, ut φαινόμενα, stellarum fixarum Ortus atq; Occa- sus, aequinoctia, dierum augescentium & deficientium uices, Eclipses & umbrae ostendunt.

page.notes: The diagram's labels are printed in a rotated or mirrored form and several planet symbols are doubtful; they are rendered approximately. The page has no page number or running head. Figure labels are given approximately.
